2027-01-16.title: Saturday after the First Sunday after Denho · The Bonds of St Peter
readings: Remember your leaders; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
2027-01-16.alt: Season of Denho. Commemoration of Bishop Geevarghese Mar Divannasios (2018). Alternative Gospels: John 10:11–18; John 14:1–6; John 15:9–17.
2027-01-16.verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
theo: Hebrews asks us to “Remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.” Today we remember two such leaders: St Peter, whose chains in prison (Acts 12) the Church honours, and Bishop Geevarghese Mar Divannasios, a shepherd of our own Church who died in 2018. Leaders pass; the one they served remains: “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.”

Jesus asks: “Who then is the faithful and wise slave, whom his master has put in charge of his household, to give the other slaves their allowance of food at the proper time? Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work when he arrives.” Every Christian is a steward of something: family, work, talents, a parish ministry. Hebrews adds the worship that pleases God: a “sacrifice of praise… the fruit of lips that confess his name”, and doing good and sharing what we have.
outline: Ask: which leader in faith do you most remember?
Found at work when he comes.
“Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.”
live: Pray today for a priest, bishop or teacher who formed your faith, living or departed.
Do today's duties well, as for the Lord.
2027-01-16.prayer: Lord Jesus, the same yesterday, today and forever, we thank you for the leaders who spoke your word to us. Give rest to Bishop Geevarghese Mar Divannasios, strengthen our shepherds as you freed Peter from his chains, and make us faithful stewards found at work when you come. Amen.
altar: Hebrews says “we have an altar” (13:10). At the Qurbono we offer the sacrifice of praise with the leaders who taught us, living and departed.

quick: Remember your leaders and imitate their faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.
Be a faithful steward, found at work when he comes.
2027-01-16.action: Pray today for a priest or teacher who formed your faith.
2027-01-16.question: What has the Lord entrusted to me, and am I faithful in it?

family.explain: Jesus told about a good servant who did his work well even when the master was away. When the master came back, he was happy!
family.intention: We pray for our bishops and priests, living and departed.
family.ask: Ask: “What job has God given each of us at home?”

illus: An old sacristan in Thiruvalla rang the church bell at 5.30 every morning for forty years, in rain and power cuts. When asked why he never missed a day, he said: the Lord may come any morning; I want him to find me at the bell rope.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, the same yesterday, today and forever, we thank you for our leaders in faith. Make us faithful stewards. Amen.
share: Remember your leaders… imitate their faith (Hebrews 13:7). Whose faith do I want to imitate?
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Where do I need his steadiness?
Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work (Matthew 24:46). What is my work for the Lord?
interc: For our bishops and priests, that they may be faithful stewards.
For the repose of Bishop Geevarghese Mar Divannasios and all our departed shepherds.
For Christians in chains for the faith, as Peter was.
For those entrusted with families and work.
For our group, that we may be found faithful.
pm.close: Father, your Son is the same for ever. Keep us faithful to the faith our leaders taught us, until he comes. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews says: remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith (Hebrews 13:7). Today we remember St Peter in chains, and Bishop Geevarghese Mar Divannasios, who served our Church and went home to God in 2018.
Leaders come and go. But Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever (Hebrews 13:8). The faith they handed on is anchored in him.
Jesus asks: who then is the faithful and wise slave, whom his master has put in charge of his household? Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work when he arrives (Matthew 24:45–46).
Each of us has been put in charge of something: a family, a job, a ministry. Let us be faithful in it, offer God the sacrifice of praise, and share what we have. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus told about a servant who did his job well even when nobody was watching. Do your homework and chores well, for Jesus!

intro: Theme: “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.”
Remembering our leaders, trusting the unchanging Lord, serving faithfully.

q: Remember the days of old, consider the years long past; ask your father, and he will inform you; your elders, and they will tell you.
Remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.
points.apply: Pray for a departed priest or teacher who formed you.

sub: Put in charge of the household.
q: So Joseph found favor in his sight and attended him; he made him overseer of his house and put him in charge of all that he had.

“Who then is the faithful and wise slave, whom his master has put in charge of his household, to give the other slaves their allowance of food at the proper time? Blessed is that slave whom his master will find at work when he arrives.
points.apply: Do your daily duties well, as for the Lord.

q: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and pay your vows to the Most High.

Through him, then, let us continually offer a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that confess his name. Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
points.apply: Share something with someone in need this week.

concl: Let him find us faithful at our work.
2027-01-16.resolve: Pray this week for all our bishops and priests, living and departed.
